- **Where:** API keys

## Rate limits

- **What it is:** Whatsable API v1 rate limits (RateLimit headers, 429 rate_limited, Retry-After), legacy API and app request limits (600 a minute per organization, 429 ERROR_CODE_TOO_MANY_REQUESTS), Meta WhatsApp throughput (80 MPS default, 20 on Coexistence), messaging limits outside the 24h window, and error 130429.
- **Plan:** Pro, Agency and the 14-day trial.
- **Who can do it:** Anyone can read it.
- **Where:** API keys
- **The agent can:** nothing here; the person does it in the app.
- **Full steps:** https://docs.whatsable.app/features/rate-limits.md. For the person: https://docs.whatsable.app/features/rate-limits

## Embed the WhatsApp connection in your own product

- **What it is:** Connect your WhatsApp Business Account to Whatsable with Meta's Embedded Signup. Meta WhatsApp Coexistence is supported, so you can keep the WhatsApp Business app on your phone.
- **Plan:** Pro, Agency and the 14-day trial.
- **Who can do it:** Owners and admins.
- **Where:** API keys
- **The agent can:** nothing here; the person does it in the app.
- **Full steps:** https://docs.whatsable.app/get-started/embedding.md. For the person: https://docs.whatsable.app/get-started/embedding
